description: The double factorial n!!. Even n uses the even factors down to 2, and odd n uses the odd factors down to 1. 0!! is 1, 6!! is 48, and 7!! is 105. n runs from 0 to 4096. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/double-factorial
